description: Facebook has launched new AI-powered tools that help you shape what you see in Feed and Reels by telling us what you’re interested in, in your own words. The new 'Your algorithm' feature allows users to share interests to fine-tune what they see, and Meta's ranking systems will adapt in real time. Facebook has also updated the three-dot menu to make it easier to access these customisation tools.
title: Facebook Introduces Your Algorithm Feature to Let Users Customise Feed and Reels

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 took over eight years to make, Rockstar Games has said in a wide-ranging interview with Bloomberg. Development on the game started after the release of Red Dead Redemption 2 and was delayed multiple times. The developer said that GTA 6 would serve as a blueprint for its future projects, which won't take as long to make.
title: Rockstar Explains Why It Took Over 8 Years to Make GTA 6, Says It Will Make Its Next Game Faster

description: Standard Chartered has launched direct cryptocurrency trading for Professional Investor clients in the UAE, following approval from Dubai’s Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority. The service allows eligible customers to trade Bitcoin and Ethereum through their existing bank accounts, with the bank managing transactions, custody, and settlement. Developed with support from Zodia Markets, the offering could expand to other markets, although the bank has not announced a rollout schedule.
title: Standard Chartered Broadens UAE Crypto Services With Direct Bitcoin and Ethereum Trading

description: Amazon’s Great Indian Festival Sale has plenty of deals on new and recently launched OnePlus products. This includes smartphones like the OnePlus Nord 6, the OnePlus Pad tablet and TWS earphones like the Nord Buds 4. Here’s all you need to know about the best OnePlus discounts happening during the sale.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Deals on OnePlus Products

description: Samsung on Wednesday announced its ‘Big, Bigger, Biggest’ festive campaign in India. As part of the festive initiative, the South Korean tech conglomerate is offering deals on its Vision AI-powered televisions ahead of Diwali. Customers purchasing select models will be eligible to receive a premium Samsung soundbar or a Vision AI TV for free. Apart from this, there are cashback benefits, zero down payment options, and free same-day installation of select TV models.
title: Samsung Announces Festive Offers on Vision AI TVs in India With Free Soundbars, Cashback Benefits

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra will be launched with an improved Privacy Display feature, according to a tipster. The South Korean tech giant is reportedly working on the second generation of the Privacy Display feature, which could offer higher resolution when the functionality is enabled. Moreover, the company could be working to improve the overall viewing angles, screen quality, and clarity of the panel. The leaker further claims that this will result in a notable price hike over the launch price of this year’s Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra. With the Galaxy S26 Ultra, the company introduced the new privacy-focused hardware solution.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra to Launch Next Year With an Improved Privacy Display, Higher Price Tag, Tipster Claims

description: The Mijia Smart Air Purifier 6 offers effective air purification, a useful set of sensors, and plenty of control through the Xiaomi Home app. During my testing, it brought indoor AQI down from just above 100 to the mid-thirties in around 20 minutes. The replacement filter is reasonably priced. Fan noise at higher speeds can also get distracting. At Rs. 19,999, it is worth considering for homes looking to tackle indoor pollution.
title: Mijia Smart Air Purifier 6 Review: Big on Features, Good at Its Job

description: Oppo has confirmed the India launch date of its Oppo Pad Mini Matte Display Edition. The new tablet will be launched on October 22 alongside the Oppo Enco X4 true wireless stereo (TWS) earphones. It is confirmed to ship with a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset. The tablet will also pack an 8,000mAh battery. It will have an 8.8-inch 2.5K OLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate.
title: Oppo Pad Mini Matte Display Edition, Enco X4 India Launch Date Announced

description: Haier hosted its ‘Elevate With Haier’ event on Wednesday in Noida. During the event, the tech firm launched its new range of large home appliances, including the new Haier In-Vista Refrigerator and M3 Series Washing Machine. Both new large home appliances are currently available for purchase in India via the Haier online store and Haier-authorised offline retail stores. The tech firm claims that the M3 Series Washing Machine is India’s first model featuring a triple-drum setup, comprising two 1kg drums and one 10kg drum, offering a total capacity of 12kg. On the other hand, the Haier In-Vista Refrigerator is said to be India’s first five-door refrigerator.
title: Haier In-Vista Five-Door Refrigerator and M3 Series Washing Machine Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Solana is scheduled to activate its Alpenglow upgrade on October 21, replacing the TowerBFT consensus mechanism used since 2020. The upgrade aims to make transactions irreversible in 150 milliseconds by changing how validators reach agreement. The transition is planned for epoch 1064 and requires compatible Agave 4.3.0 software, while alternative validator clients will not support the initial migration.
title: Solana’s Alpenglow Upgrade Set for October 21 With 150-Millisecond Finality Target

description: God of War Laufey is getting a collector's box, featuring a light-up statue of Faye, a deck of custom cards, and an artbook. The box does not include the game itself. The collector's box is available to pre-order in select regions via PlayStation Direct. It will go on sale when God of War Laufey launches on November 19.
title: God of War Laufey Is Getting a $150 Collector's Box, but It Does Not Come WIth the Game

description: Poco X8s has reportedly appeared on Singapore’s Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) certification website, suggesting that the smartphone could be nearing its launch. The listing identifies Poco as the brand and Xiaomi Electronics as the applicant. The listing confirms 5G connectivity. It was also spotted on the Geekbench website.
title: Poco X8s Spotted on IMDA Certification Website; Launch Seems Imminent

description: HP ZBook Ultra G3a has been launched in India, the company announced on Wednesday. The new laptop is currently on sale in the country via HP authorised offline and online retail partners. The HP ZBook Ultra G3a is offered in a single grey colour option. It is capable of supporting local AI workloads, including LLMs with up to 300 billion parameters. The laptop is powered by up to an AMD Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 processor. Moreover, the new HP ZBook Ultra G3a packs a 96Wh battery. It is claimed to deliver up to 14 hours of battery life on a single charge. It also features a 16-inch OLED display.
title: HP ZBook Ultra G3a Launched in India With Up to AMD Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 Processor, 16-Inch OLED Display: Price, Specifications

description: Ripple is integrating Privy’s programmable wallet technology into the XRP Ledger to help developers build payment systems within applications. The infrastructure will support wallet creation, management, and transaction signing for XRP, Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin, and other XRPL assets. Privy also sees potential for server-side wallets that allow AI agents to make payments, as Ripple reports that agent transactions account for roughly 25 percent of network activity.
title: Ripple Teams Up With Stripe’s Privy to Enable XRP Payments in Apps

description: Google announced an expansion of the capabilities of the Google Play Store on Tuesday. As per the Mountain View-based tech giant, users can now create and run their own Android apps with AI tools and natural language prompts, eliminating the need of having a developer account. There are also new ways to discover apps and games on the Play Store, with AI-powered recommendations and personalised game discovery tools rolling out. Users can also discover and access Play Store content in Gemini.
title: Google Play Store Adds Vibe-Coded Apps, AI App Comparisons and Personalised Game Discovery

description: After years of rumours, Apple finally launched its first foldable iPhone this year. The iPhone Duo runs on the same iOS 27 operating system as other non-foldable iPhones, but it has been tailored for a dual-screen experience. While the hinge connecting the two screens usually presents an engineering challenge, especially when tackling heat dissipation, Apple appears to have taken an unconventional approach to this problem. Apple executives have reportedly revealed that the iPhone Duo’s thermal design leverages a flexible component inside the hinge to help move heat across the foldable.
title: How Apple Uses the Hinge to Cool the iPhone Duo

description: Google Pay announced a new rewards programme for its Flex co-branded credit card in India on Wednesday. As part of the changes, users can now take advantage of higher savings on everyday spending. There are also additional benefits for eligible Google One members. The Flex credit card, notably, is issued in partnership with Axis Bank and SBI Card. It offers rewards in the form of Stars, which can then be redeemed against eligible Flex payments within Google Pay or used to get discounts on gift vouchers.
title: Google Pay Flex Credit Card Gets New Rewards: More Stars on UPI Spending, Google One Benefits

description: OnePlus 16R has been the subject of the rumour mill in recent weeks. A tipster now claims that Realme could be developing a smartphone with hardware similar to OnePlus’ mid-flagship. It is said to feature a 200-megapixel primary camera, a dedicated telephoto sensor, and gaming-focused hardware. As per the tipster, the purported Realme handset could be in the same category as the OnePlus 16R, featuring a flat OLED screen, a built-in cooling fan, and up to an 185Hz refresh rate.
title: Upcoming Realme Phone With OnePlus 16R-Like Specs Leaked; May Get Built-In Cooling Fan, RGB Light

description: Amazon's Great Indian Festival 2026 sale kicked off last week, bringing discounts on a range of devices. The platform has listed many window ACs from leading brands at reduced rates. In addition to the sale prices, you can save more through bank offers and exchange discounts. Here we have listed the best window AC deals available in the Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026. You can check the features, installation charges, warranty coverage and energy rating before placing an order.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Window AC Deals

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026 started last week.  The sale is the right time for buyers looking to get Amazon Fire TV streaming devices at discounted prices. In addition to the listed sale prices, eligible shoppers can reduce the effective cost by applying bank offers and exchange benefits. Amazon Fire TV Stick HD is marked down to Rs. 2,999, instead of Rs. 5,499.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026: Best Deals on Fire TV Stick and Streaming Devices

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 will reportedly launch on PC in the first quarter of 2027. According to a new report, the Rockstar plans to release the PC version of the game before the end of March 2027—just months after the game's launch on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X. GTA 6 is slated to release on current-gen consoles on November 19, 2026.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Will Reportedly Launch on PC Before the End of March 2027

description: The Oppo Find X10 series is set to be launched in India soon. The upcoming flagship lineup will comprise two models — Oppo Find X10 and the Find X10 Pro Max. The company recently announced the launch date of the handsets. Ahead of their anticipated debut, retail box labels of the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max have reportedly surfaced. These offer a glimpse at the listed prices of the upcoming handsets, along with their dimensions, weight, and details about their in-box accessories.
title: Oppo Find X10, Find X10 Pro Max India Prices Leak via Retail Box Labels Ahead of Launch

description: Oppo launched the Android 17-based ColorOS 17 update on Tuesday in select global markets, including India. Apart from this, the company has announced the ColorOS 17 release schedule for Oppo, OnePlus, and Realme devices. The Oppo Find N6, Oppo Find X9 series, Oppo Pad 5 Pro, OnePlus 15, OnePlus Pad 4, and Realme GT 8 Pro series will be among the first devices to receive the new Android 17-based update. The OS will be released on October 29. The new software ships with the Living Flow Design, comprising Oppo’s Luminous Effect, Fluid Motion, and Flexible Feedback. The Luminous Effect element brings more translucent and softer visuals to the UI, along with a refined dynamic lighting effect that aims to guide a user’s attention.
title: ColorOS 17 Launched Globally: Android 17 Features, Eligible Oppo, OnePlus and Realme Devices

description: At its Unpacked 2026 event, Samsung revealed basic details about its upcoming Galaxy Glasses, due to launch in November this year. A new leak has revealed more details, including frame designs and key specifications. Samsung tied up with lifestyle brands Gentle Monster and Warby Parker to design the frames for its Galaxy Glasses.
title: Samsung Galaxy Glasses Leak Reveals Frame Designs, Specifications and Features Ahead of November Launch

description: Bitcoin remained above $83,000 as traders assessed ETF redemptions, elevated oil prices and uncertainty over US monetary policy. Strive added 3,311 BTC to its holdings, while improving on-chain trends suggested renewed accumulation by large investors. However, continued outflows from Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs have kept market sentiment cautious ahead of the US inflation report.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $83,000 as ETF Outflows and Global Market Caution Weigh on Sentiment

description: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G, Galaxy M47 5G, and Galaxy F70 Pro 5G prices in India have been hiked again, according to a report. The report highlights that Samsung has increased the prices of all three smartphones by Rs. 2,000 across RAM and storage configurations. For reference, the Samsung Galaxy A27 5G is now reportedly priced in India at Rs. 35,999, up from Rs. 33,999 for the base 6GB + 128GB variant. Meanwhile, the higher-end 8GB + 128GB and 8GB + 256GB options now reportedly cost Rs. 42,999 and Rs. 47,999, rising from Rs. 40,999 and Rs. 45,999, respectively. Similarly, the Samsung Galaxy M47 5G and Galaxy F70 Pro 5G prices in India are said to now start at Rs. 37,999, rising from Rs. 35,999, for the base 6GB + 128GB model.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 5G, Galaxy M47 5G and Galaxy F70 Pro 5G Prices in India Reportedly Hiked Again Amid Ongoing RAM Crisis

description: iQOO posted several teasers offering a first look at the iQOO Neo 12's front panel. The smartphone is shown with a flat display featuring narrow bezels and a centrally aligned hole-punch cutout for the front-facing camera. iQOO Neo 12 is set to launch in China later this month. The iQOO Neo 12 is teased to feature a 2K display with a 185Hz refresh rate. It is confirmed to pack a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and a dedicated Q3 gaming chip
title: iQOO Neo 12 Design, Display Specifications Teased Ahead of Launch

description: Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026 has listed a number of dishwasher models from brands like Hisense, Hafele, IFB, Midea, and Bosch at relatively low prices. The ongoing Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale 2026 is offering the Hisense 15 Place Settings Dishwasher at a discounted price of Rs. 31,590, marking a discount of Rs. 20,000 from its listed price of Rs. 51,990. Similarly, the IFB 14 Place Settings with DeepClean Technology Freestanding Dishwasher is available at a relatively low price of Rs. 42,790, instead of its listed price of Rs. 49,990. Apart from direct price cuts, you can avail an instant discount of 10 percent, up to Rs. 57,750, with an SBI credit or debit card and SBI credit card EMI transactions. Alternatively, you can get a 5 percent cashback with an Amazon Pay ICICI Bank credit card.
title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026: Best Dishwasher Deals From Hafele, IFB, Bosch and More
